# Chat Widget API — operations

7 operations. Full request and response shapes: [reference.md](reference.md).

- `chat-widget.clone-chat-widget` — **Clone a Chat Widget** — `POST /chat-widget/clone` (write, location)
  Clones an existing chat widget into a new widget
- `chat-widget.create-chat-widget` — **Create a new chat widget** — `POST /chat-widget/` (write, location)
  Creates a new chat widget for a specific location
- `chat-widget.delete-chat-widget` — **Delete a Chat Widget** — `DELETE /chat-widget/{locationId}/{id}` (write, location)
  Deletes a chat widget by ID
- `chat-widget.get-chat-widget-by-id` — **Get Chat Widget by ID** — `GET /chat-widget/data/{locationId}/{id}` (read, location)
  Returns the full chat widget configuration for the given location and widget ID
- `chat-widget.list-chat-widgets` — **List Chat Widgets** — `GET /chat-widget/list` (read, location)
  Retrieves a list of chat widgets for a specific location
- `chat-widget.patch-chat-widget` — **Patch Chat Widget** — `PATCH /chat-widget/data/{locationId}/{id}` (write, location)
  Applies a partial update to an existing chat widget
- `chat-widget.update-chat-widget` — **Update Chat Widget** — `PUT /chat-widget/data/{locationId}/{id}` (write, location)
  Replaces an existing chat widget with the provided configuration
